reviews.text: For my Sophie, the entire staff at La Zampinoteca has become a true second family, or as I call them, her "uncles"! I don't bring Sophie here out of pure necessity or because I wouldn't know where to leave her, but by choice. When she's with them, I feel completely safe and at peace. The best proof of this is that she comes home so happy, tired, and relaxed after hours spent playing at the facility. Rating: 10 out of 10! Highly recommended.
Excellent group management, respect for each dog's personality, and clear communication with us owners as well. Knowing she's in good hands gives me peace of mind. Thank you so much for everything!

Dog daycare where you can trust and feel completely at ease.
Great availability and courtesy, always available for helpful advice.
Attentive and well-organized dog daycare, the guest, as soon as he approaches, "the guest" can't wait to enter.
Even though I'm not lucky enough to be their customer, I still give them 5 stars for their kindness and sincerity.
Great, helpful, passionate, and competent. I'm so lucky to have found them.

Excellently run dog daycare with great compassion. Even when caring for a dog can be challenging (surgeries, illness, etc.), they meet the needs of their owners, leaving them with peace of mind when entrusting their pet.
Leo has been coming several times a week for several years now.
